headline_marked: US launches [[new airstrikes to punish Iran]] after 2 troops killed
headline: US launches new airstrikes to punish Iran after 2 troops killed
summary: The US military has carried out its eighth consecutive night of strikes following Iranian attacks in Jordan that left two American service members dead.
details: The United States launched new airstrikes on Saturday to punish Iran after reporting the first US military deaths since renewing hostilities with the Islamic republic.
The strikes followed Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks in Jordan on Friday, which killed two US service members and left another missing in action.
CENTCOM announced this was the eighth consecutive night of strikes, targeting the port of Sirik on the Strait of Hormuz to degrade Iran's ability to threaten commercial shipping.
Iran's supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei vowed to teach the US "unforgettable lessons," while a senior military adviser warned of full-scale offensive operations if strikes continue.
The conflict has escalated further with Iran targeting oil facilities in Kuwait and air bases in Bahrain and Jordan, while the Jordanian army reported shooting down multiple missiles.
According to the health ministry, 50 people have been killed and over 500 injured since the renewed fighting broke out.
The violence was sparked by Iranian attacks on ships in the strategic Strait of Hormuz, a vital transport lane for Gulf energy exports.
Hope for a political settlement has diminished as both nations continue to exchange strikes, with reports of civilian casualties and infrastructure damage in southern Iran.
caption:
Two US service members killed in Jordan sparks a new wave of American airstrikes on Iran.

The United States launched new airstrikes on Saturday to punish Iran after reporting the first US military deaths since renewing hostilities with the Islamic republic.

The strikes followed Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks in Jordan on Friday, which killed two US service members and left another missing in action.

CENTCOM announced this was the eighth consecutive night of strikes, targeting the port of Sirik on the Strait of Hormuz to degrade Iran's ability to threaten commercial shipping.

Iran's supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei vowed to teach the US "unforgettable lessons," while a senior military adviser warned of full-scale offensive operations if strikes continue.

The conflict has escalated further with Iran targeting oil facilities in Kuwait and air bases in Bahrain and Jordan, while the Jordanian army reported shooting down multiple missiles.

According to the health ministry, 50 people have been killed and over 500 injured since the renewed fighting broke out.

The violence was sparked by Iranian attacks on ships in the strategic Strait of Hormuz, a vital transport lane for Gulf energy exports.

Hope for a political settlement has diminished as both nations continue to exchange strikes, with reports of civilian casualties and infrastructure damage in southern Iran.

headline: 4 more children die of cholera in Ham Gulf
summary: The death toll rises as 1,051 people have now been infected by the disease in the region.
details: Four more children have died due to cholera in the Ham Gulf area.
The total number of infected people in the region has now reached 1,051.
Health authorities are monitoring the situation as the outbreak continues to spread among the vulnerable population.
Efforts are being made to contain the disease and provide medical treatment to those affected.
